deviations: final.py: deviations / interpretation choices, written 2026-10-07T03:22:33+05:30 BEFORE any seed-robustness run or final assembly was executed.

FD1 Final system = the protocol's factorized nested procedure (4.3: stage 1 by inner C1 over all 24 configs, then the full 672 downstream grid by inner C, paired 1-SE rule, refit, D fallback). That procedure was already run to completion on the full grid (no shrink) by build_post-onset-rul.py --part N (seed base 42, n_jobs 3; cache/post-onset-rul/part_N.pkl). final.py imports that module (no re-implementation) and REUSES that run as the primary (confirmatory) N rather than recomputing an identical result. A joint (non-factorized) 24 x 672 search is not run: the protocol specifies the factorized procedure.

FD2 Seed robustness (not pre-registered in the protocol; robustness evidence only, never used for selection or the ship decision): two further complete nested runs of the identical procedure with seed base 1042 and 2042 (random_state = base + outer fold for every inner and refit stage-2 model; base + 15 for the all-15 modal run). Stage 1, TSO and conformal are deterministic, so only ET/HGB-q fits change. The two runs execute concurrently with n_jobs 2 each (4 threads total). ET is invariant to n_jobs; HGB-q may differ at float-rounding level. Each run has its own 3 h cap. The protocol decision is taken from the primary run; the report states whether the decision, gates, fold choices and modal configuration change under the other seeds.
FD3 Fold fallback (4.2) uses D's outer output, which is deterministic (TSO) and so identical across seeds.

FD4 Interpretation choices inherited unchanged from post-onset-rul DV1-DV9 (pre_onset provisional; warm-up gated for pipelines, R0/R1 ungated per 4.5; FPT = hard-latch first onset; p0 from inner states; published interval [q10, q90] at alpha 0.1).

FD5 Timeline CSV (results/final_timeline.csv): one row per bearing x snapshot for N (primary seed) with D and R0 states beside it; 'true_onset' = 1 from the GT primary onset row (gt_on_row) on, with gt_early_row/gt_late_row edges given as flags; predicted_rul/interval are null while healthy (output contract 2.3).
FD6 Output naming: results/final.json and results/final_timeline.csv (the task's names) instead of protocol_results.json / per_bearing.csv; per-bearing metrics also in results/final_per_bearing.csv.

FD7 (added 2026-10-07T03:29:20+05:30, after the smoke-test report of the PRIMARY run only, which reproduces post-onset-rul.json exactly; no seed result or R0-variant result had been computed or seen): EXPLORATORY, post-hoc, not pre-registered, never a ship candidate: "R0_ratchet" = R0's frozen state mapping (causal.states_r) passed through the protocol ratchet (faulty/critical never demoted; same arithmetic as causal.replay's hard-latch branch: max(inst, cummax(inst where inst>=2))), plus the same with degrading also latched ("R0_latch_all"). Purpose: the integration plan must say whether the model-independent semantic fixes (ratchet + reset, required by P6 for any pipeline) change production's cost/event profile if applied to the incumbent model. Reported with the full gate set for information only; the protocol decision (section 4.4) is not affected.
inherited_deviations: post-onset-rul track: deviations / interpretation choices, written 2026-10-06T23:41:26+05:30 BEFORE any stage-2 model was fit or any D/N result was seen.

DV1 pre-onset semantics: pipeline_states(pre_onset="provisional") (harness2 default): stage-2 conditions while O=0 are evaluated at a provisional onset = current row (tso=0); published q50 stays null while healthy. Chosen because PROTOCOL 2.2 counters run concurrently and the 1.3 latency floors assume it.
DV2 warm-up: N/D/D'/variants go through causal.replay, which gates rows < 20 (healthy). R0/R1 keep the frozen ungated causal.states_r mapping as primary (as harness2 / section 4.5).

DV3 stage-2 training and conformal-calibration rows: rows at/after the stage-1 HARD-LATCH first onset (FPT) of each training bearing, for both hysteresis options (hysteresis only changes the replay). Bearings with no onset contribute no rows.

DV4 feature details the protocol leaves open: OLS slopes of log r5 over trailing 10/30 rows (fewer rows early, 0 with <2 rows); kurtosis z = robust z vs commissioning median/MAD, floor max(1.4826*MAD, 0.02*|med|), max over h/v, trailing 5-row median; envelope ratio = max_c env_rms_c / med20_c, unsmoothed, log; r5-based features use the stage-1 reference mode (self/fallback); peak and kurtosis/envelope use the commissioning median.
DV5 TSO: L = median over training bearings with an onset of true RUL at their causal FPT (same as harness2.p1_baselines). At provisional pre-onset rows TSO q50 = L.

DV6 HGB-q: early_stopping=False set explicitly (identical to sklearn 'auto' at < 10000 rows). Seeds: random_state = 42 + outer fold for every inner and refit model of that outer fold; the all-15 modal run uses 42 + 15.

DV7 published output: interval [q10, q90] at alpha 0.1 with the chosen binning, whatever model_crit alpha is selected; failure_within_horizon_probability from q05/q10/q50/q90/q95 (alpha 0.05 and 0.1 bounds) via harness2.prob_within; p0 for O=0 rows (and warm-up rows).
DV8 p0 = bearing-equal mean, over the 14 training bearings with any O=0 row >= 20, of the fraction of those rows with RUL <= 120, using the selected candidate's inner replay states.
DV9 stage-1 selection scores stage-1 configs under the hard latch (stage-1 only states). If no stage-1 config is eligible, D's stage 1 is used (logged).

DV10 EXPLORATORY variants requested by the task, outside the pre-registered decision: (a) ORACLE: onset latched at the GT primary point t_on (gt_on_row; trigger = row >= gt_on_row, k = 1), stage 2 trained on rows after each training bearing's gt_on_row. This uses the GT as an onset input, which PROTOCOL 1.1/1.4 forbids for candidates; it is a diagnostic upper bound only and never a ship candidate. (b) SIMPLEST: stage 1 fixed to ratio 1.3/k3/self (first in complexity order, = D's stage 1), downstream selected by the nested rule. Only the full nested N (stage 1 also selected) is confirmatory.
DV11 output naming: results go to results/post-onset-rul.json (+ per-bearing CSV) as the task specifies; this track does not write run_nested.py/report.py or protocol_results.json.
DV12 D and D' are computed first (written to results/post-onset-rul_D.json) before any other candidate is scored.

DV13 pilot/shrink: the 2.5 h projection and the pre-set shrink order are applied to the full nested N run (pilot = outer fold 0). Exploratory variants run after N and are skipped (and reported) if the 3 h cap would be exceeded.

DV14 (added 2026-10-07T00:01:57+05:30, after the pilot timing only; the pilot's fold-0 choice was seen in the log, no N cost/outer result was looked at): the pilot projected N at 1.84 h (< 2.5 h, so NO grid shrink; full 672 grid). The exploratory variants (N_simplest, N_oracle, D_oracle, descriptive grid) would add about 3 h in sequence, so they run in a SEPARATE process (--part explo), concurrently with the N process (--part N), single-threaded (ET n_jobs=1, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1) to keep total threads at 4. ExtraTrees results do not depend on n_jobs; HGB-q may differ at float-rounding level from a 3-thread fit. Exploratory only; the confirmatory N/D/D' run is unchanged (n_jobs 3). A final --part report step assembles both and writes post-onset-rul.json. The 3 h cap is applied to the N process.
